lines.text: المسير المعدَّل فاقسِم عليه نُقْصان الاختلاف الثالث من الثاني فما حصل فجزء من ساعة فانقُصه من ساعات
lines.plain: المسير المعدَّل فاقسِم عليه نُقْصان الاختلاف الثالث من الثاني فما حصل فجزء من ساعة فانقُصه من ساعات

lines.plain: الاختلاف الثاني فما بلَغَتْ ساعات الاختلاف الثاني بَعْدَ ذلك فهي الساعات المُحْكَمَة. فإِذا عرَفْتَ

lines.text: ساعات الاختلاف المُحْكَمَة من أيّ الجِهتَيْن وَقَعَتْ فاضرِبها في مَسِير القمر ومَسِير الشمس المختلِفَيْن{mR:15}
lines.plain: ساعات الاختلاف المُحْكَمَة من أيّ الجِهتَيْن وَقَعَتْ فاضرِبها في مَسِير القمر ومَسِير الشمس المختلِفَيْن

lines.text: في تلك الساعة واحفَظ ما يحصُل من كلّ واحد منهما فإِن كان بُعْد القمر عن الطالع في ذلك الوَقْت
lines.plain: في تلك الساعة واحفَظ ما يحصُل من كلّ واحد منهما فإِن كان بُعْد القمر عن الطالع في ذلك الوَقْت

lines.text: اقلَّ من تسعين فانقص ساعات الاختلاف الثاني المُحْكَمة من ساعات الاجتماع الحقّيّ وحَرَكة
lines.plain: اقلَّ من تسعين فانقص ساعات الاختلاف الثاني المُحْكَمة من ساعات الاجتماع الحقّيّ وحَرَكة

lines.text: الشمس في ذلك المقدار من مَوْضِع الاجتماع وكذلك تنقُص حركة القمر من موضع الاجتماع ومن
lines.plain: الشمس في ذلك المقدار من مَوْضِع الاجتماع وكذلك تنقُص حركة القمر من موضع الاجتماع ومن

lines.text: حاصَّة القمر ومن حركة العرض وتنقُص من حركة العرض مع ذلك مَسِير العَقْد في مقدار ساعات
lines.plain: حاصَّة القمر ومن حركة العرض وتنقُص من حركة العرض مع ذلك مَسِير العَقْد في مقدار ساعات

lines.text: الاختلاف الثاني فإِن كان بُعد القمر عن الطالع اكثر من تسعين استعْمَلْتَ الزيادة في جميع ذلك بَدَلًا{mR:20}
lines.plain: الاختلاف الثاني فإِن كان بُعد القمر عن الطالع اكثر من تسعين استعْمَلْتَ الزيادة في جميع ذلك بَدَلًا

lines.text: من النقصان فما حصلت ساعات الاجتماع الحقّيّ بَعْدَ الزيادة او النقصان فهي ساعات وَسَط الكسوف
lines.plain: من النقصان فما حصلت ساعات الاجتماع الحقّيّ بَعْدَ الزيادة او النقصان فهي ساعات وَسَط الكسوف

lines.text: وكذلك موضع الشمس والقمر وحركة العرض وحاصّة القمر المقوَّمة لوَسَط الكسوف فاعرِف عند
lines.plain: وكذلك موضع الشمس والقمر وحركة العرض وحاصّة القمر المقوَّمة لوَسَط الكسوف فاعرِف عند

lines.text: ذلك عرض القمر وجِهَته بحركة العرض في وسط الكسوف فاحفَظها ثمّ خُذْ بُعد ساعات وسط
lines.plain: ذلك عرض القمر وجِهَته بحركة العرض في وسط الكسوف فاحفَظها ثمّ خُذْ بُعد ساعات وسط

lines.text: الكسوف عن نصف النهار واعرف بها اختلاف منظر القمر في العرض على ذلك الرَّسْم بَعْدَ أن
lines.plain: الكسوف عن نصف النهار واعرف بها اختلاف منظر القمر في العرض على ذلك الرَّسْم بَعْدَ أن

observations: L04, L05, L07, L08, L09, L15, L17, L18, L19, L22, L23, L24: long joins (ثالثـةً, the first, and مثـل on L04; فـإِنّ and عليهـا on L05; بُعـد and النهـار on L07; تلـك at the end of L08; فمـا at the end of L09; مـن on L15; مـن, twice, on L17; ومـن at the end of L18; مقـدار on L19; المقوَّمـة and عنـد on L22; خُـذْ and بُعـد on L23; النهـار and بَعْـدَ on L24) are not transcribed; nor the long kāf of وحَرَكة at the end of L17.

The page has 24 lines of text and no notes: it has no rule, and the text runs to the foot of the page. The lines run the full measure (115 to 538 pt at the head, 115 to 539 pt at the foot). Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the right margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20; L21 to L24 have no number. The folio number «f. 114,r.» stands in the left margin beside L10, where the asterisk stands between الثاني and الذي.

L20: تسعين: the tā' is printed without its two dots, in both copies: nothing stands over the first tooth of the word; the dot at the left is that of the nūn and the two dots under the word are those of the yā'. The word is transcribed in full. تسعين on L02, L03 and L17 has the two dots of the tā'.

The anomaly: حاصَّة (L19) and وحاصّة (L22) are printed without a dot over the first letter, as on the pages before; over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha in one cluster on L19 (3.6 x 4.3 pt) and the shadda alone on L22.

L07: نصف: the join between the ṣād and the fā' is broken: the nūn and the ṣād are one piece (7.2 x 4.3 pt) and the fā' begins further left, with a speck on the baseline in the gap between them; the gap is in both copies. The word is transcribed in full. نصف on L04 and L24 is whole.

L17: الاختلاف: the tā' is printed as a small knot on the baseline (1.8 x 1.8 pt), apart from the khā' and from the lām-alif, with its two dots over it, at the left of the dot of the khā'; so in both copies. L21: the second الكسوف, at the end of the line: the join between the kāf and the sīn is broken, with a small piece on the baseline in the gap (1.4 x 1.8 pt). The words are transcribed in full.

The exact hours: المُحْكَمَة (L11, L14, L15): a damma high over the ligature of the lām and the mīm (2.2 to 2.5 x 4.0 to 4.7 pt, its top 15.1 to 15.4 pt over the baseline), a round sukun over the ḥā' (a ring in the second copy), a fatha over the kāf and a fatha low over the mīm (2.9 to 3.6 x 1.8 pt, its top 9.0 pt over the baseline), at the right of the two dots of the tā' marbūṭa; so in both copies. المُحْكَمة (L17): the damma, the sukun and the fatha over the kāf; nothing stands over the mīm, in both copies. A full stop follows the word on L14.

The distance: بُعْد (L02, L16): a damma over the bā' and a round sukun over the ʿayn; بُعْدها (L03): the same. بُعد (L07, L20, L23): the damma alone (2.2 x 4.7 to 5.0 pt); nothing stands over the ʿayn, in both copies where compared (L07, L20).

The hamza stands on the line in جزء (L02, L08), جُزْء (L04) and فجزء (L11, L13). It stands bare over the alif in أن (L05, L24), فأخذتَّ (L09) and أيّ (L15) (2.2 to 3.2 x 2.5 to 3.2 pt). With a fatha in one cluster: أَعْني (L02: 3.2 x 5.0 pt) and أَمَرْتُك (L10: 3.2 x 4.7 pt). The hamza and its kasra stand under the alif in one cluster (3.2 x 4.3 to 4.7 pt) in فإِن (L02, L04, L16, L20), فإِنّ (L05), وإِن (L06, L11) and فإِذا (L14). وان (L03), او (L06, L21), ايضًا, اقلَّ, اكثر and استعْمَلْتَ have no hamza.

Final yā': with its two dots in الثاني (L01, L02, L05, L06, L07, L08, L09, L10, L11, L12, L13, twice on L14, L17, L20), في (L04, L08, L09, L12, L15, twice on L16, L18, L19, L20, L23, L24), التي (L05, L07), الذي (L10), هي (L06), فهي (L11, L14, L21), أَعْني (L02), أيّ (L15), بَقِيَ (L10) and الحقّيّ (twice on L03, L05, L17, L21); without dots in على (twice on L01, L03, L06, L07, L08, L09, L10, L11, L12, L24).

الحقّيّ (twice on L03, L05, L17, L21): so printed; a shadda over the qāf, above its two dots, and a shadda over the yā', whose two dots stand under it. اقلَّ (L02, L12, L17): over the lām a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). اكثر (L03, L20): no signs.

L01: فاقسِمْه: a kasra under the sīn and a round sukun over the mīm; فاقسِم (L10, L13): a short kasra (2.5 x 1.4 pt) and no sukun. سَبْق (L01, L09, L12): a fatha over the sīn and a round sukun over the bā'. خرَج: a fatha over the rā'.

L02: أَعْني: a round sukun over the ʿayn, at the left of the hamza; nothing stands under the nūn but the two dots of the yā', in both copies. فانقصها (L02) and فانقص (L17): no signs; فانقُصه (L13): a damma over the two dots of the qāf (2.5 x 4.7 pt) and no sukun; ينقُص (L12): the damma over the dots (2.5 x 4.7 pt); تنقُص (L18) and وتنقُص (L19): the damma, on L18 joined to the dots in one piece (3.6 x 4.7 pt).

L04: ايضًا: the fathatan. ثالثةً (twice): the fathatan over the tā' marbūṭa, above its two dots. فاعرِف (L04, L22): a kasra under the rā' and no sukun; واعرف (L24): no signs. جُزْء: a damma over the jīm and a round sukun over the zāy, above its dot; جزء (L02, L08) and فجزء (L11, L13): no signs; in فجزء the dot of the fā' stands high over the ligature of the fā' and the jīm (its top 12.3 to 12.6 pt over the baseline). المقوَّم (L04, L08) and المقوَّمة (L22): over the wāw a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks).

L05: فإِنّ: a shadda over the nūn. حصَلَتْ (L05, L07): a fatha over the ṣād, a fatha over the lām (a short one on L07: 2.2 x 1.4 pt) and a round sukun over the tā'; حصل and حصلت elsewhere: no signs. بَعْدَ (L05, L14, L21, L24): a fatha over the bā', a round sukun over the ʿayn and a fatha over the dāl. زِدْتَّ (L05): a kasra under the zāy, a round sukun over the dāl and over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks); زِدتَّ (L07): the kasra and the shadda with its fatha; nothing stands over the dāl. فزِدْه (L11): a kasra under the zāy and a round sukun over the dāl; فزدها (L03) and فزده (L12): no signs.

L06: نقَصْتَها: a fatha over the two dots of the qāf, a small flat sukun over the ṣād (2.5 x 1.8 pt; a filled oval in both copies) and a fatha low over the tā', above its two dots (3.6 x 2.2 pt, its top 9.3 pt over the baseline). ونقَصْتَه (L09): the same, with a round sukun (2.5 x 2.5 pt; a ring in the second copy). وَسَط (L06, L21) and لوَسَط (L22): a fatha over the wāw and a fatha over the sīn; وسط (twice on L23): no signs. The full stop after الكسوف.

L07: عرَفْتَ (L07, L14) and وعرَفْتَ (L08): a fatha over the rā', a round sukun over the fā', above its dot, and a fatha over the tā' (a short one on L14: 2.5 x 1.4 pt). يزيد: no signs; the two dots of its first yā' are cast on the foot of the ligature of the yā' and the zāy. ثمّ (L07, L23): a shadda over the mīm.
L08: سُدْس: a damma over the first sīn and a round sukun over the dāl.

L09: فأخذتَّ: over the tā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). ضرَبْته: a fatha over the rā' and a round sukun over the bā'; over the tā' its two dots only. ستّة (L09, L12): a shadda over the tā', above its two dots.

L10: بَقِيَ: a fatha over the bā', a kasra under the qāf, beside the two dots of the yā', and a fatha over the yā'. المعدَّل (L10, L13): over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks). أَمَرْتُك: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the rā' and a damma over the tā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt, its top 15.5 pt over the baseline). بحِفْظه: a kasra under the ḥā' and a round sukun over the fā', above its dot.
L11: بلَغَتْ (L11, L14): a fatha over the lām, a fatha over the ghayn and a round sukun over the tā'; بلَغ (L12): a fatha over the lām.

L12: فخُذْ: over the khā' a damma printed short (its head of 1.8 x 2.5 pt and a speck of its tail), in both copies, and a round sukun over the dhāl, above its dot. خُذْ (L23): a short damma (1.8 x 3.6 pt) and the sukun; وخذ (L03): no signs. فاضرِبه (L12) and فاضرِبها (L15): a kasra under the rā'.
L13: نُقْصان: a damma over the nūn (2.2 x 4.7 pt, its top 15.5 pt over the baseline) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf; النقصان (twice on L21): no signs.

L15: أيّ: a shadda over the yā'. الجِهتَيْن: a kasra under the jīm, a fatha low over the tā', above its two dots, and a round sukun over the yā'. وَقَعَتْ: a fatha over the wāw, a fatha high over the two dots of the qāf (its top 13.6 pt over the baseline), a fatha over the ʿayn and a round sukun over the tā'; so in both copies. مَسِير (L15, L19) and ومَسِير (L15): a fatha over the mīm and a kasra under the sīn. المختلِفَيْن: a kasra under the lām, a fatha over the fā' and a round sukun over the yā'.

L16: واحفَظ: a fatha over the fā', above its dot, and no sukun; فاحفَظها (L23): the same. يحصُل: a damma over the ṣād. كلّ: a shadda over the lām. الوَقْت: a fatha over the wāw and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf.

L17: وحَرَكة: a fatha over the ḥā' and a fatha over the rā'; حركة elsewhere, وحركة and بحركة: no signs. L18: مَوْضِع: a fatha over the mīm, a round sukun over the wāw and a kasra under the ḍād; موضع (L18, L22): no signs. L19: العَقْد: a short fatha over the ʿayn (2.5 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the two dots of the qāf.

L20: استعْمَلْتَ: a round sukun over the ʿayn, a fatha low over the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt, its top 9.3 pt over the baseline), at the right of the top of the lām, a round sukun close over the top of the lām and a short fatha over the tā' (2.5 x 1.4 pt); two rings in the second copy. بَدَلًا: a fatha over the bā', a fatha over the dāl and the fathatan over the lām-alif.

L23: وجِهَته: a kasra under the jīm, beneath its dot, and a fatha over the hā', at the right of the two dots of the tā'; so in both copies. L24: الرَّسْم: over the rā' a shadda with a fatha above it (two marks) and a round sukun over the sīn.
A mark of the master scan only, not transcribed: a round dot high over the alif of فإِن on L16 (1.1 x 1.1 pt, 14.8 to 13.7 pt over the baseline). The second copy has nothing there.
